counterfactual_missing_items: history of significant acne vulgaris or rosacea
decisive_items: non-erythematous, non-pitting edema of the left periorbital region
numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most consistent support from the vignette, including the description of non-erythematous, non-pitting edema and the presence of dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics. R4 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, but it is less consistent with the overall clinical presentation.

rejected.why: lack of other typical scleroderma features
lack of visual symptoms and other typical Sjögren syndrome features
lack of other typical lymphedema features
